Use case: identity-preserve. Edit FIRST reference W10 into one independent CAST W7/16 animation sprite. 1254x1254, real transparent alpha, full body, one character.
Image1 is STRICT W anatomy, camera, head/body scale, two grounded boot positions, costume and prop ownership reference. Image2 supplies face/identity details only; image3 is the primary approved clean bright rounded Taoist chibi hand-painted style.
Preserve the nose looking SCREEN LEFT, same SIDE VIEW with one main blue eye visible; do not rotate toward viewer. Keep the EXACT global scale and two foot contact positions of image1, soles near y95%, rootx50%, head top near y8%, do not shift or zoom the character. Both feet planted, knees flex smoothly, torso bends according to phase. Both boots visible.
ANATOMY AUTHORITY: Image1's large visible shoulder at screen RIGHT belongs to the NEAR LEFT arm. That arm is EMPTY, no fan, and connects to the near sleeve across the foreground. Its hand performs the casting gesture. The FAR RIGHT arm BEHIND chest always holds the ONE open fan by black pivot at screen LEFT. NEVER switch hand ownership. Near empty arm and its sleeve remain in FRONT OF fan when they overlap. Keep two continuous arm-to-shoulder connections. Two arms/two hands only.
EXACT UNIQUE PHASE 7: 聚气07：左手诀从脸下向前推半掌距离，右扇在头侧最高位置展开，右肘弯，胸廓微提。 Highest charge: FAR RIGHT hand holds open fan at HIGHEST head-side position on screenLEFT, pivot beside temple and fan rim a little ABOVE ponytail top. Fan entirely inside canvas. NEAR EMPTY LEFT seal pushes only half a palm away from chin toward screenLEFT, elbow still bent. Slight lifted sternum. Exact fixed boots and camera.
Translate this unique phase through shoulder/elbow/wrist/finger joints, never freeze the prior hand positions. Fan movements are performed by FAR RIGHT arm. The NEAR LEFT empty hand transitions between open palm, two-finger Taoist seal and relaxed hand as specified. At seal, index and middle fingers are pressed parallel together, other fingers curled. Preserve all identity details: navy straight hair ponytail, jade/gold hair ornament, blue ribbons, blue eyes, ornate blue/ivory/gold wave embroidered robe, white trousers, blue-gold boots. Jade pendant on visible NEAR LEFT hip below large screen-right shoulder, never migrate hips. Fan is a physical ivory fan with blue water dragon painted on paper, not an actual dragon.
Maintain original head size and feet positions from first image, allowing only purposeful knee and torso movement. Sleeves/tassels follow motion gently. Entire fan and hair inside canvas. Focused alert expression.
NO water, no glow, no magic, no particles, no aura, no floor, no shadow, no background, no text or watermark. Independent west drawing, no horizontal mirror. Polished chibi sprite.
